maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from pawn loans and sales of pre-owned merchandise to consumers, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private consumers paying for pawn loans and used goods; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from operating and opening pawn stores and growing loans and sales; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to another pawn shop, lender or used-goods retailer; no integration or regulatory switching cost.
